name: Qays ibn al-Khatim
bio: Qays, known as Abu Yazid, belonged to the Aws of Yathrib before the Hijra. Much of his poetry recalls the struggles of the Aws and Khazraj, including the day of Bu'ath. Ibn Sallam says some critics preferred him to Hassan ibn Thabit and declines to rank them himself. Al-Zirikli places his killing around two years before the Hijra, about 620 CE.
